steps.en: Scaffold a new project from any directory
steps.zh: 在任意目录下脚手架一个新项目

steps.en: Prompts for project name, package manager and which integrations to include
steps.zh: 提问项目名、包管理器，以及要包含哪些集成

steps.en: Answer the prompts, or pass the whole selection as flags
steps.zh: 回答提问，或把全部选择作为旗标一次给足

steps.en: Resolves integration dependencies and conflicts, renders templates, merges package.json and installs
steps.zh: 解析依赖与冲突，渲染 EJS 模板，合并依赖并安装

steps.en: Start the dev server and open the app
steps.zh: 启动开发服务器，打开应用

value.en: A running TanStack Start project with auth, ORM and deploy wiring composed from 29 integrations — vendor boilerplate never passes through your hands
value.zh: 认证、ORM、部署接线都组合到位的可运行项目——厂商样板代码完全不经你的手

sources: README.md Quick Start (npx @tanstack/cli create my-app; --integrations tanstack-query,clerk,drizzle)
docs/quick-start.md (interactive prompts for name/package manager/integrations; cd my-app; pnpm dev; .tanstack.json)
AGENTS.md at repo root (engine compiles selected integrations into a project with EJS templating; API fetches integration definitions from the GitHub integrations/ folder)
docs/cli-reference.md (tanstack create options incl. --integrations, -y; tanstack integration init/compile)
